name: archi-agent
description: Grounded architecture diagram generation with local or cloud models: validated PlantUML sequence diagrams from flow descriptions and an Architecture Knowledge Pack.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In an untrusted workspace the Knowledge Pack path and local model settings are read from user settings only.

virtualWorkspaces.description: The Knowledge Pack and flow files are read from the local file system.

archiAgent.knowledgePackPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path of the Architecture Knowledge Pack directory (the folder holding `systems.md`, `actors.md`, `relationships.md`, `aliases.md` and `rules.md`). The directory may be anywhere on the local file system; it is never resolved relative to a workspace or the working directory.

archiAgent.localModel.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL of the local OpenAI-compatible server (for example LM Studio). Only literal loopback URLs are accepted: `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/v1` or `http://[::1]:<port>/v1`.

archiAgent.localModel.model.markdownDescription: Legacy LM Studio model identifier. Existing effective user, workspace and workspace-folder values remain compatible until a provider profile is explicitly selected. New model selections are stored in `archiAgent.localModel.selectedModel`.

archiAgent.localModel.profile.markdownDescription: Provider profile used on this computer. Cloud API keys are stored separately in VS Code SecretStorage. This machine-scoped choice is not synchronized by Settings Sync and cannot be overridden by a workspace. Use **Archi Agent: Select Provider Profile** to change it.

archiAgent.localModel.selectedModel.markdownDescription: Model selected for the explicit provider profile on this computer. This machine-scoped choice is not synchronized by Settings Sync and cannot be overridden by a workspace.

archiAgent.localModel.selectedModelProfi.markdownDescription: Internal binding between the selected model and its provider profile. Archi Agent manages this machine-scoped setting automatically; do not edit it manually.

archiAgent.localModel.timeoutSeconds.markdownDescription: Time limit in seconds for one model request.

archiAgent.defaultAuthor.markdownDescription: Author written into the front matter when a flow is entered as a plain description instead of a flow document.
